[LTA Important Notice]
According to our system records, your vehicle still has an outstanding ERP (Electronic Road Pricing) bill. Due to insufficient funds in your OBU-linked payment account, the automatic deduction was unsuccessful. Please log in to the LTA temporary payment portal immediately at：hxxps://onemotoring[.]lta[.]gov@unpid[.]com/sg to complete the payment. Please note that a late payment penalty will be incurred if payment is not made within 24 hours, and you may face further investigation by law enforcement. If you have already made the payment, please disregard this notice.

(Please reply "y" to close this message, reopen the message to activate the link, or copy the link and open it in the Safari browser.)
